reason: My register has never failed me and I know every bill in it. My staff are already unsettled after two stylists left, so making them take selfies and type every customer's number into a phone is the wrong time to start.
objection: Many of my customers won't give their mobile number, so half the bills won't go in and the reminders and wallet are useless for them. Then I am paying every month and still keeping the register.
would_change_my_mind: If a salon owner I know nearby shows me it actually caught cash going missing from the drawer, and I can bill a customer without a mobile number.
